history.p: Post-attention output gating numerical mechanism. Three source token representations produce full standard attention for current SECOND query. Attention result TWO coordinates then multiplied per coordinate by a sigmoid gate from CURRENT query representation ONLY, independently projected. Gate applied AFTER entire weighted sum, not to scores or attention probabilities. Two paths converge at empty elementwise-multiply circle, then TWO-coordinate output row. Explicit attention weights THREE cells, THREE source value rows with TWO columns optional if composition suits. Gate TWOcells (future values .2,.8) and attention TWOcells(.5,1.25), output(.1,1.0) all blank. No source deletion or sparse graph induced. Keep original simple clean causal-dependency routing, rich mechanism glyphs.
